maya: Quick heads-up 	6: All-hands tomorrow 10:00 PT (20m). Short agenda + Q&A doc below. Please drop questions here or add to the doc. :calendar:

maya: Agenda (20m):
- 10:00-10:04 Exec update (priorities + hiring asks)
- 10:04-10:10 Product highlight  Dedicated routing & latency improvements (demo)
- 10:10-10:14 Policy & ops  new default debug retention + runbook small change
- 10:14-10:20 Live Q&A (top upvoted)

maya: Q&A doc: https://docs.google.com/redwood-allhands-q2-tactics (add + upvote)

jon: Can we include a one-line blurb about the runbook change? it's low-risk but ops-facing.

maya: Yes  we'll mention it in the policy segment. Paste the short blurb here if you have it.

jon: TL;DR: runbook now performs a fast preflight healthcheck and auto-escalates to oncall+team lead after 2 failed retries. Tests added to CI.

srini: Policy note: default debug-index retention will be set to 45 days starting next week; projects may opt out via Project Settings > Data retention. Migration guidance is in the Q&A doc.

kate: APAC folks: recording + slides will be posted immediately; we'll host a 17:00 SGT follow-up office hour for regional Qs.

all-hands-bot: Calendar reminder posted: All-hands  Q2 Tactical Update  Tomorrow 10:00 PT (link in #general).

recording-bot: Recording link (uploaded after meeting): https://records.redwood.co/meetings/1879001234-q2-tactics.mp4 (slides: https://slides.redwood.co/allhands/1879001234)

maya: Post-meeting takeaways (short):
- Exec: focus remains reliability + platform SLAs; approved hiring for +3 infra roles.
- Product: routing change reduces tail latency on stress tests by ~12% without added cost.
- Policy/Ops: default retention -> 45 days; opt-out path documented; runbook preflight & auto-escalation deployed with weekly smoke tests.

maya: If your Q in the doc wasn't answered live we'll follow up here and update the notes. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
